Integrations

# Connect transaction data to iPayX.

Bank sync available in the US and Canada via Plaid. CSV/PDF audit available globally. More corridors and regions planned.

## Supported sources

PlaidAvailableUS & Canada

Read-only bank connectivity via Plaid. Automatic FX transaction extraction from North American bank accounts.

Manual uploadAvailableGlobal

Import transactions via CSV or PDF. The OCR engine automatically extracts and normalizes FX data.

API ingestionAvailableGlobal

Send transactions directly via REST API. Ideal for ERP, treasury, and platform integrations.

ERP / TreasuryComing soonGlobal

Structured imports from ERP systems and treasury platforms. In development.

## How it works

Data source

Normalization

FX audit engine

Structured results

Every data source is normalized into a unified format, analyzed by the FX audit engine, then returned as structured JSON results, dashboard, or widget.

## Use cases

### Treasury visibility

Give treasury teams a structured view of their real FX costs vs. mid-market rates.

### Hidden spread detection

Automatically identify invisible bank margins on every FX transaction.

### Cross-border payment review

Analyze real costs for every international payment corridor.

### Embedded client audit

Embed a white-label FX audit workflow into your own product or platform.
